DTCs.name: Wheel Speed Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Detected malfunction in the wheel speed sensor circuit.

DTCs.name: ABS Pump Motor Malfunction
DTCs.description: ABS pump motor is not operating correctly.

DTCs.name: Brake Fluid Level Low
DTCs.description: Brake fluid level is below the minimum threshold.

DTCs.name: Brake Pedal Switch Failure
DTCs.description: Brake pedal switch signal is not detected by ECU.

DTCs.name: ABS Hydraulic Pressure Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Pressure sensor in ABS hydraulic system is not within range.

DTCs.name: Electronic Parking Brake Fault
DTCs.description: Electronic parking brake did not engage or release correctly.

DTCs.name: Brake Booster Vacuum Leak
DTCs.description: Vacuum level in brake booster is below operating specification.

DTCs.name: Brake Pad Wear Sensor Activated
DTCs.description: Brake pad wear sensor triggered due to low pad thickness.

DTCs.name: ABS Relay Failure
DTCs.description: ABS relay did not switch properly or is faulty.

DTCs.name: Brake Line Pressure Imbalance
DTCs.description: Uneven hydraulic pressure detected between left and right brakes.
